headline.zh: 上海南站咖啡打卡人气第1名
headline.en: Top-rated coffee spot near Shanghai South Railway Station

traits.zh: 小型独立店，临街玻璃窗，店内有木质柜台和少量座位
traits.en: Small standalone shop with street-facing glass windows, wooden counter, and limited seating

traits.zh: 大落地窗提供采光，可见室外街道
traits.en: Large floor-to-ceiling windows provide natural light and street views

traits.zh: 饮品包括抹茶拿铁等冷饮
traits.en: Serves matcha latte and other cold drinks

traits.zh: 咖啡豆香气明显，味道浓郁
traits.en: Strong aroma and bold flavor from the coffee beans

focus.zh: 仅少量座位，无办公设施证据
focus.en: Limited seating, no evidence of work setup

linger.en: Limited seating, not designed for long stays

adventure.zh: 提供抹茶拿铁，豆香明显但无手冲/自烘证据
adventure.en: Serves matcha latte; bold beans but no evidence of roasting or pour-over
